name: Play a land on turn 1-2 against a Labyrinth-lane opponent, with nothing to imprint yet
intent: On turn 1 or 2, against the Labyrinth lane (broodscale-bloodchief, devoted-combo, dimir-frog, goryos-vengeance, instant-reanimator, living-end), once open-labyrinth-land's own hand-imprint-target count does NOT hold (no colorless mana value 7 or greater card in hand yet), play a land using the same fallback order open-tron-land reads against every other lane: a missing Urza's piece, then Eldrazi Temple by its own 'colorless Eldrazi' text, then a basic - no Labyrinth-first tier, since there is nothing worth imprinting on it this turn and ranking it ahead of Tron progress would cost tempo for no upside. Hand case: T1 Ugin's Labyrinth + Urza's Tower + Urza's Mine + Expedition Map, no 7-drop, against living-end - this play takes over from open-labyrinth-land, which used to wrongly rank Labyrinth first here with nothing to imprint (see decks/eldrazi-tron/NOTES.md 'Known limits (opening plays)', fixed 2026-09-14). Ugin's Labyrinth can still be the land actually picked once neither fallback tier narrows anything (it always enters untapped; its own imprint trigger is answered may/choose_cards regardless of whether a legal exile target is in hand, riding along the same as open-tron-land's own). Same archetype gate as open-labyrinth-land, and its own hand-imprint-target count sits byte-identical in this play's false list, so the two are provably exclusive - together they cover the whole Labyrinth lane exactly the way open-labyrinth-land alone used to, with no coverage gap. Excludes the Temple lane and the Tron lane the same way its sibling does. Chains into map-for-tron-missing-piece the same way. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up, or once an imprint target is in hand (open-labyrinth-land's own true key). Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
